metadata.title: An Obstruction to Realizing Aspherical $3$-Manifold Groups via Torus Surgery
metadata.abstract: Let $Y$ be a closed, connected, oriented, aspherical $3$-manifold with fundamental group $\pi = \pi_1(Y)$ and positive first Betti number $\beta_1(Y) > 0$, and let $X_0 = Y \times S^1$. We prove that no torus surgery on $X_0$ along a torus-fibered $T^2$-knot $T \subseteq X_0$ can yield a $4$-manifold $X = X_{0; T, f}$ with fundamental group $\pi$. The obstruction combines the vanishing of the Euler characteristic of $X$ with a classifying-map argument showing that the unimodular intersection form on $H^2(X; \mathbb{Z})$ must admit an isotropic subgroup of rank $\beta_1(\pi)$, forcing $\chi(X) \geq 2$. Along the way, we also present an independent geometric proof via covering space theory, the Sphere Theorem, and Scott's Core Theorem that the fundamental group of a closed aspherical $3$-manifold is torsion-free.

analysis.workSummary: 设 Y 为闭连通定向且为 K(π,1) 的三维流形且 b₁(Y)>0。在 X₀=Y×S¹ 中，作者排除沿环面纤维化 T² 结的环面手术产生基本群为 π₁(Y) 的闭四维流形。若术后基本群同构于目标群，分类映射将在交叉形式的自由部分中给出秩 b₁(Y) 的全迷向子群，迫使 χ(X)≥2，与手术保持 χ(X)=0 矛盾。
techniques: 覆盖空间、球面定理与 Scott 核定理
analysis.breakthrough: 利用第一 Betti 数与交叉形式的秩约束阻止一类基本群实现，同时给出闭 K(π,1) 三维流形群无挠性的几何证明。
analysis.limitations: 原问题要求沿环面纤维化 T² 结手术，并以 b₁(Y)>0 为假设。证明中的交叉形式按整数上同调自由部分理解。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
